# DMS Studio

> DMS Studio is an interior design studio based in Mohali, Punjab, India. Led by founder Megha Sahni, the studio creates thoughtful residential and commercial interiors across Mohali and the Tricity region.

## About

- Website: https://www.dmsstudio.in/
- Founder: Megha Sahni
- Studio: DMS Studio – Interior Designer
- Location: SCO 1034, Basement, near Arista Hotel, Sector 125, Sunny Enclave, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Kharar, Punjab 140301, India
- Phone: +91 70874 19592
- Email: dmsstudiomohali@gmail.com
- Service areas: Mohali, Chandigarh, Panchkula, Zirakpur, Kharar, and New Chandigarh

## Services

- [Residential interiors](https://www.dmsstudio.in/services/residential-interiors/): Interior design for homes and apartments.
- [Turnkey interiors](https://www.dmsstudio.in/services/turnkey-interiors/): End-to-end interior planning and execution.
- [Commercial interiors](https://www.dmsstudio.in/services/commercial-interiors/): Thoughtful spaces for businesses, including salons and workplaces.
- [Kitchens, storage and lighting](https://www.dmsstudio.in/services/modular-and-lighting/): Practical modular planning, storage and lighting design.

## Selected projects

- [Babbar Residency, Mohali](https://www.dmsstudio.in/projects/babbar-residency/): A family home with a deep green feature wall, mustard seating and warm timber.
- [Opera Home, Mohali](https://www.dmsstudio.in/projects/opera-home/): A compact apartment with bohemian textures and careful remote coordination.
- [Essentia Salon, New Chandigarh](https://www.dmsstudio.in/projects/essentia-salon/): A commercial salon interior.

## Notes

For a new project conversation, share the property location, plans or current photographs if available, the rooms to be addressed, and the main priorities. DMS Studio can then discuss the next appropriate step.
